entries.what: Isabel walked to Flats High, went through AP classes, then studied at the library homework center until Grace could pick her up.
Did dishes after dinner, checked that Lola Cora took her lunch-time pills, then worked on a SAT practice section with a kitchen timer.
entries.outcome: Practice section done, 2 of 2 for the week started.

entries.what: At lunch Isabel and Lucas talked about robotics leadership, and she wondered how admissions would see captain versus subteam lead. That evening she worked it over at home.
Robotics practice in room C7 on the drivetrain, then home for a late dinner with the family.
Tutored Mateo in fractions at Kessler Middle from 4 to 5, using pizza drawings.
entries.outcome: Mateo got through a full worksheet and she collected $20.

entries.what: Isabel found a state university summer engineering institute and decided to apply, noting the Nov 15 deadline in her planner.
Late at night she read about the program on Ramón's old desktop and went to bed around 1.
Made a week-by-week AP Calc review schedule at the library homework center to protect her A before the next test.
Robotics in C7 from 3:30 to 6, working on the mechanical subteam's arm mount.
Ate Lola Cora's dinner with Grace and Corazón, avoiding the bitter melon.
entries.outcome: Dinner passed with only one snipe about homework.

entries.what: Checked the SAT fee waiver status and learned she qualifies for it but not for application waivers at most private schools.
entries.outcome: Added application fees to her savings tally.

entries.what: Turned in an essay draft to Ms. Lugo, who reads one draft per student on Fridays, then went with Nadia to get tea at Cloud Nine.
entries.outcome: Got jasmine milk tea and a ride home.

entries.what: Spent the evening at the Egrets game-free home night, studying APUSH reading with film scores on.
Walked to the library for Harper's Saturday SAT prep, timing each section with the kitchen timer.
entries.outcome: Score on practice math section improved.

entries.what: Passed the line of people at the Ridgeline hiring fair on the way home and heard Ramón had a day off, so he took her driving in the Ruel Road lots.
entries.outcome: Practiced parallel parking without hitting a cone.

entries.what: Photographed a heron by the marsh at dusk and logged it in her tally notebook.
entries.outcome: One more bird on the tally.

entries.what: Went to Tagalog Mass with Grace and Lola Cora, then helped with Sunday sinigang lunch.
That night in draft hell she asked for a fourth rewrite of a paragraph already called strong, then said she'd sit on it instead of sending it.
Finished the evening doing dishes and setting the calc schedule for the week.
